messages:
alex-sales: Heads-up: RidgeBank asked if we can run a focused POC to validate streaming SDK + function calls + structured JSON output. Key asks: throttling behavior, error visibility, and a quick hosted vs dedicated price delta for a 12h test. Can we support next Wed?
nina-se: yes. approach: websocket streaming, function_call streaming mode, enable strict schema validation at close. i'll prepare a short runbook (20-30m).
corey-runtime: throttling summary: per-connection inflight limit, global route quota, and advisory headers `X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining`. oversubscribe -> 429 + `Retry-After`. suggest client circuit breaker + backoff.
corey-runtime: sample advisory headers:
```
X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining: 1200
X-Redwood-Inflight: 3
```
tamara-ae: RidgeBank also asked about observable traces and PII handling for audit. we need SOC2 link + KMS notes.
sec-bot: SOC2: https://redwood.internal/soc2 (internal). KMS pattern doc: https://redwood.internal/kms. redact reminder: remove account numbers before sharing traces.
alex-sales: pricing note: can we get a rough pct difference for 12h with peak 10k qps? hosted vs dedicated?
corey-runtime: quick calc: dedicated ~25-35% cheaper at sustained high throughput. i'll add a short spreadsheet and hourly reserve numbers in the runbook.
nina-se: i'll include sample JS + curl snippets for streaming function calls and an example failure event payload so their engineers can handle schema errors.
corey-runtime: example failure event: `{ "type": "struct_error", "trace_id": "t-99", "errors":[{"path":"/items/0/price","msg":"not a number"}] }`
tamara-ae: i'll handle SOW & DPA phrasing for pilot ownership of prompts/outputs.
alex-sales: thanks — plan: runbook + pricing sketch + security Qs by EOD Mon, schedule 30-min lab next Wed. tagging folks. :thumbsup:
